title: Exploring Tuning of Structural and Magnetic Properties by Modification of Ancillary β-Diketonate Co-ligands in a Family of Near-Linear Tetranuclear DyIII Complexes

material_class.structural_family: near-linear tetranuclear Dy4 cluster with a zigzag Dy4 core of three contiguous Dy2O2 rings

synthesis.procedure: Complexes 1–3 were prepared by a common procedure. LH4 (0.168 mmol) in CH3OH/CHCl3 (1:1, 30 mL) was treated with Dy(NO3)3·xH2O (0.337 mmol) and stirred 10–15 min. Triethylamine (1.012 mmol) was added, causing precipitation that dissolved upon addition of the β-diketone co-ligand RR1acac (0.516 mmol; R = R1 = CH3, acetylacetone, for 1). The mixture was stirred 12 h at room temperature, the solvent was stripped in vacuo to a yellow powder, and crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were grown by slow evaporation of a redissolved 1:1 MeOH/CHCl3 solution within 10 days.

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 1.012 mmol (reported as 0.140 μL in the specific quantities for 1)

synthesis.time: stir 10–15 min after metal addition; 12 h after co-ligand addition; crystals within 10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis followed by vacuum stripping and slow evaporation crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: complete stripping of solvent in vacuo gave a yellow powder; suitable crystals from slow evaporation of a 1:1 MeOH/CHCl3 solution within 10 days

properties.summary: Near-linear Dy4 cluster showing slow magnetic relaxation at low temperature (χm'' finite up to 10.0 K at zero dc field) but Cole–Cole curvatures insufficient for detailed relaxation fitting. DC χmT at 0.1 T is 53.35 cm3 K mol−1 at 290 K and 27.46 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K; magnetization at 2.0 K reaches 21.1 NAμB (1.5–5.0 T), consistent with weak exchange among four Dy3+ centers.

measurements.name: slow relaxation of magnetization (out-of-phase ac susceptibility)
measurements.conditions: zero dc bias field; ac 1–1000 Hz; applied static fields up to 1000 Oe did not improve the accessible frequency window

material_class.structural_family: near-linear tetranuclear Dy4 cluster (hmacac analogue) with methanol solvate

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the common procedure for 1–3, substituting 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedione (hmacacH) for acetylacetone. LH4 (0.168 mmol) in CH3OH/CHCl3 (1:1, 30 mL) was treated with Dy(NO3)3·xH2O (0.337 mmol), then triethylamine (1.012 mmol) and hmacacH (0.516 mmol). After 12 h stirring at room temperature the solvent was removed in vacuo; crystals were obtained by slow evaporation from 1:1 MeOH/CHCl3 within 10 days.

properties.summary: Shows slow magnetization relaxation at zero dc field with three temperature regimes (lower-T process, transition, higher-T process). Higher-T Orbach fit: τ0 = (6.3 ± 3.6)×10−6 s, Ueff = 16.6 ± 2.8 cm−1 (23.8 ± 4.0 K). Lower-T fit: τ0 = (4.4 ± 1.5)×10−8 s, Ueff = 27.0 ± 1.0 cm−1 (38.8 ± 1.4 K), QTM rate B = 1589 ± 20 s−1. DC χmT = 53.55 cm3 K mol−1 at 290 K and 32.43 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K; Mm ≈ 21.0 NAμB at 2.0 K (1.5–5.0 T).
